records.key: A selected volume surface does not exist.
records.source: A selected volume surface does not exist.
records.translation: 所选的体积表面不存在。

records.key: A view-drawn volume needs finite increasing view limits before editing.
records.source: A view-drawn volume needs finite increasing view limits before editing.
records.translation: 在视图中绘制的体积在编辑前需要有限且递增的视图范围。

records.key: A volume anchor needs three finite coordinates.
records.source: A volume anchor needs three finite coordinates.
records.translation: 体积锚点需要三个有限坐标。

records.key: A volume must have nonzero extent on all three axes.
records.source: A volume must have nonzero extent on all three axes.
records.translation: 体积在三个轴上的范围都必须不为零。

records.key: A volume scale must be positive and finite.
records.source: A volume scale must be positive and finite.
records.translation: 体积缩放比例必须为正且有限。

records.key: An editable volume needs 4 to 8192 vertices and at most 16384 triangles.
records.source: An editable volume needs 4 to 8192 vertices and at most 16384 triangles.
records.translation: 可编辑体积需要 4 到 8192 个顶点，且最多 16384 个三角形。

records.key: An editable volume requires three distinct measurement columns.
records.source: An editable volume requires three distinct measurement columns.
records.translation: 可编辑体积需要三个不同的测量列。

records.key: An edited outline must have distinct points and nonzero area.
records.source: An edited outline must have distinct points and nonzero area.
records.translation: 编辑后的轮廓必须具有互不相同的点和非零面积。

records.key: An edited outline must have nonzero area.
records.source: An edited outline must have nonzero area.
records.translation: 编辑后的轮廓必须具有非零面积。

records.key: An edited outline needs at least three finite points.
records.source: An edited outline needs at least three finite points.
records.translation: 编辑后的轮廓至少需要三个有限点。

records.key: An unbounded gate needs explicit finite view limits before editing its volume.
records.source: An unbounded gate needs explicit finite view limits before editing its volume.
records.translation: 无界门控区域在编辑其体积前需要明确的有限视图范围。

records.key: Anchor density
records.source: Anchor density
records.translation: 锚点密度

records.key: Anchor density must be between 1 and 8.
records.source: Anchor density must be between 1 and 8.
records.translation: 锚点密度必须介于 1 到 8 之间。

records.key: Anchor visibility must be true or false.
records.source: Anchor visibility must be true or false.
records.translation: 锚点可见性必须为真或假。

records.key: Constrain anchor and surface movement to a data axis, or drag in the view plane. The selected axis also controls wheel movement.
records.source: Constrain anchor and surface movement to a data axis, or drag in the view plane. The selected axis also controls wheel movement.
records.translation: 将锚点和表面的移动限制在一个数据轴上，或在视图平面内拖动。所选轴也控制滚轮移动。

records.key: Drag to draw the chosen shape on the chosen plane.
records.source: Drag to draw the chosen shape on the chosen plane.
records.translation: 拖动以在所选平面上绘制所选形状。

records.key: Drag to turn the volume.
records.source: Drag to turn the volume.
records.translation: 拖动以旋转体积。

records.key: Edit volume anchors and surfaces. Ctrl-click selects multiple surfaces; the wheel moves them together. Curved gates become a piecewise-linear boundary on the first committed edit.
records.source: Edit volume anchors and surfaces. Ctrl-click selects multiple surfaces; the wheel moves them together. Curved gates become a piecewise-linear boundary on the first committed edit.
records.translation: 编辑体积锚点和表面。Ctrl 单击可选择多个表面；滚轮会一起移动它们。弯曲的门控区域在第一次确认编辑时会变为分段线性边界。

records.key: Edit volume surfaces: Ctrl-click selects several. Edit axis constrains motion. Curved gates become piecewise-linear when edited. View-drawn and unbounded gates use the current view's finite depth at the first committed edit.
records.source: Edit volume surfaces: Ctrl-click selects several. Edit axis constrains motion. Curved gates become piecewise-linear when edited. View-drawn and unbounded gates use the current view's finite depth at the first committed edit.
records.translation: 编辑体积表面：Ctrl 单击可选择多个。编辑轴限制移动方向。弯曲的门控区域在编辑后变为分段线性。在视图中绘制的和无界的门控区域在第一次确认编辑时使用当前视图的有限深度。

records.key: Edited outline edges must not cross or overlap.
records.source: Edited outline edges must not cross or overlap.
records.translation: 编辑后轮廓的边不得交叉或重叠。

records.key: Editing an outline anchor commits a piecewise-linear boundary; counts and exports use that same boundary.
records.source: Editing an outline anchor commits a piecewise-linear boundary; counts and exports use that same boundary.
records.translation: 编辑轮廓锚点会确认一条分段线性边界；计数和导出使用同一边界。

records.key: Editing this anchor commits a piecewise-linear volume. View-drawn and unbounded gates use the current view's finite depth.
records.source: Editing this anchor commits a piecewise-linear volume. View-drawn and unbounded gates use the current view's finite depth.
records.translation: 编辑此锚点会确认一个分段线性体积。在视图中绘制的和无界的门控区域使用当前视图的有限深度。

records.key: Evenly subdivide gate edges and surfaces into editable anchors. Density changes handles, not the gate's geometry or membership.
records.source: Evenly subdivide gate edges and surfaces into editable anchors. Density changes handles, not the gate's geometry or membership.
records.translation: 将门控区域的边和表面均匀细分为可编辑锚点。密度只改变控制柄，不改变门控区域的几何形状或成员归属。

records.key: Every volume triangle must name three existing vertices.
records.source: Every volume triangle must name three existing vertices.
records.translation: 每个体积三角形都必须指定三个已有顶点。

records.key: Only a three-dimensional gate can become an editable volume.
records.source: Only a three-dimensional gate can become an editable volume.
records.translation: 只有三维门控区域才能变为可编辑体积。

records.key: Rotate the graph to expose that axis before dragging its anchors.
records.source: Rotate the graph to expose that axis before dragging its anchors.
records.translation: 拖动该轴的锚点前，请旋转图表使该轴可见。

records.key: Saved anchor controls are invalid.
records.source: Saved anchor controls are invalid.
records.translation: 已保存的锚点设置无效。

records.key: Show gate anchors
records.source: Show gate anchors
records.translation: 显示门控区域锚点

records.key: Spin
records.source: Spin
records.translation: 旋转

records.key: The editable view boundary must stay finite and in front of its camera.
records.source: The editable view boundary must stay finite and in front of its camera.
records.translation: 可编辑的视图边界必须保持有限并位于其相机前方。

records.key: The editable view volume must remain in front of its camera.
records.source: The editable view volume must remain in front of its camera.
records.translation: 可编辑的视图体积必须保持在其相机前方。

records.key: The selected volume anchor does not exist.
records.source: The selected volume anchor does not exist.
records.translation: 所选的体积锚点不存在。

records.key: The view camera cannot resolve an editable volume boundary.
records.source: The view camera cannot resolve an editable volume boundary.
records.translation: 视图相机无法确定可编辑的体积边界。

records.key: The view camera has no finite editable depth.
records.source: The view camera has no finite editable depth.
records.translation: 视图相机没有有限的可编辑深度。

records.key: The volume footprint must be a simple nondegenerate polygon.
records.source: The volume footprint must be a simple nondegenerate polygon.
records.translation: 体积底面必须是简单的非退化多边形。

records.key: The volume footprint must have finite nonzero extent on both axes.
records.source: The volume footprint must have finite nonzero extent on both axes.
records.translation: 体积底面在两个轴上都必须具有有限的非零范围。

records.key: The volume must enclose a nonzero region.
records.source: The volume must enclose a nonzero region.
records.translation: 体积必须包围一个非零区域。

records.key: This gate has no supported finite editable volume boundary.
records.source: This gate has no supported finite editable volume boundary.
records.translation: 此门控区域没有受支持的有限可编辑体积边界。

records.key: View plane
records.source: View plane
records.translation: 视图平面

records.key: Volume coordinates, triangles and surface groups are invalid.
records.source: Volume coordinates, triangles and surface groups are invalid.
records.translation: 体积坐标、三角形和表面组无效。

records.key: Volume motion needs existing vertices and a finite three-axis displacement.
records.source: Volume motion needs existing vertices and a finite three-axis displacement.
records.translation: 移动体积需要已有顶点和三个轴上的有限位移。

records.key: Volume sampling needs 8 to 128 circumference samples and 1 to 16 depth intervals.
records.source: Volume sampling needs 8 to 128 circumference samples and 1 to 16 depth intervals.
records.translation: 体积采样需要 8 到 128 个圆周采样和 1 到 16 个深度区间。

records.key: Volume surfaces must be connected and use every vertex.
records.source: Volume surfaces must be connected and use every vertex.
records.translation: 体积表面必须相互连通并使用每个顶点。

records.key: Volume surfaces must form one closed consistently oriented mesh.
records.source: Volume surfaces must form one closed consistently oriented mesh.
records.translation: 体积表面必须构成一个封闭且朝向一致的网格。

records.key: Volume surfaces must not intersect or overlap.
records.source: Volume surfaces must not intersect or overlap.
records.translation: 体积表面不得相交或重叠。

records.key: Volume triangles must not collapse.
records.source: Volume triangles must not collapse.
records.translation: 体积三角形不得退化。

records.key: Volume vertex indices must be integers.
records.source: Volume vertex indices must be integers.
records.translation: 体积顶点索引必须为整数。

records.key: Volume vertices must be finite and distinct.
records.source: Volume vertices must be finite and distinct.
records.translation: 体积顶点必须有限且互不相同。

records.key: {x} × {y} × {z}: {count} volume anchors
records.source: {x} × {y} × {z}: {count} volume anchors
records.translation: {x} × {y} × {z}：{count} 个体积锚点

review_scope: AI technical review; no native-speaker signoff.
